oldSaveBehavior: Recap opens when visitOpen is absent. Prior saves cannot distinguish an intentional exit from a close during an Expo.
newSaveBehavior: The earned ending is awarded once. A close while visitOpen is true permits re-entry. The next uncompleted record restarts. A gift-shop exit or panic clears visitOpen. A genuinely new run clears archive progress and retains the planter lifetime.
scenarios: quit resumes the Expo archive, while exit, panic and legacy recaps stay closed
abandoned, stale and interrupted events cannot advance progress
the planter claims the lifetime on first landing, including a visit abandoned before the first cue
a simultaneous planter claim cannot start a second set of timed cues
a save round-trips the run and the lifetime
a save with no run keeps the lifetime: that is what New run writes
